reuse.why: Changes the rule in the existing shared getScheduledAmount and replaces three inline midpoint copies with calls to it, but leaves the forecast's copy untouched.

duplication.why: Removes duplicated range logic from three sites; schedule-template still keeps its own isbetween ternary and forecast-schedules keeps a midpoint copy.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the existing home of getScheduledAmount used by both server and client.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Mostly consolidated into one helper, but one missed copy now disagrees with the new rule.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts now holds the rule for preview, postTransactionForSchedule, updateActions, schedule-template and client UI, but packages/loot-core/src/server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule still computes the rounded midpoint itself
